title.narrative: Developing innovative food solutions to increase quality of nutritious foods for young children, adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women.

description.narrative: This applied research will be structured around the following outcomes: -To determine the commercial feasibility, and nutritional potential, of egg-based food solutions in the future delivery plans of the Productive Safety Net Programme (PSNP); -To determine the commercial feasibility, and nutritional potential, of a product made of dried papaya in the future delivery plans of the PSNP; -To assess the feasibility of improving folate status through injera (Ethiopian Staple) using novel microbial strains.
